title: journal_entry.posted
description: Emitted by post_journal_entry after a balanced entry is written to the ledger. Carries the logical entry shape, not the pair-decomposed storage rows.

schema_version.description: Bumped on breaking shape change. Consumers branch on it.

openly_operated.description: Set at emit time from local SSM tenant metadata. The publication rule's filter.

customer_id.description: Tenant identifier. Redundant with envelope account-id but saves consumers a join.

entry_id.description: Idempotency key matching the ledger row. Either supplied by caller or generated uuid.

posted_at_ms.description: ms-epoch timestamp when the entry was written.

origin.description: Provenance tag. Renamed from input `source` to avoid envelope-`source` collision. Examples: stripe, square, manual.

line_items.description: Logical entry shape. Sums to zero across DEBIT/CREDIT (kirchhoff check happens in the lambda pre-emit; not expressible in JSON Schema).

counters.description: Economic-index signals, stamped ONLY when the entry carries one (a revenue credit today). The platform's counter lambda applies them with no accounting knowledge — this module decides what revenue is and how much; the platform just adds. Absent means no signal, which is why it is optional rather than an empty array.

op.description: How the counter lambda applies it. Only additive today.

key.description: The counter to move, e.g. `revenue`. The lambda partitions it by the event's month.

magnitude.description: The amount to add. Positive; direction lives in `op`.
